n: The letter zeta (ζῆτα), the sixth letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.

ζ̅.m: Lower-case zeta, the seventh letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. Its name was ζῆτα. The sound it represented is disputed, some claim it was /zd/, others claim it was /dz/. It is preceded by ϝ and followed by η
